spring.applies_to: spatial feedback only; never progress, alpha or data values

progress.pause: stop sheen immediately; authoritative late acknowledgments may update the boundary statically without implying running
progress.completion: verified durable receive receipt; never animation end

reduced_motion.state: immediate final geometry with persistent icon/text/outline

lifecycle.domain_mutations: explicit user events and authoritative responses, never mount or animation completion

input.hover: fine-pointer only; equivalent focus and press feedback
input.keyboard: preserve multiline input and native composition; Enter/Space activate a focused button
